title: GKOS v0.82.1 — Developmental specification / public working draft
description: Governed Knowledge Operations Standard (GKOS), developmental specification / public working draft. Documentation patch v0.82.1 clarifies publication status and existing exact-bound claims controls. The project name, titles and identifiers are retained. Technical requirements, schemas, runner behavior, GKX 2.0, 62 permanent allocations and 28 gate codes are unchanged from v0.82. R23 remains prospective; no profile is qualified and no implementation claim carries forward automatically. Owner-authorized, non-consensus and non-qualifying. Public GitHub visibility, signatures, CI and archival do not establish standards maturity, certification or regulatory acceptance. Documentation and original graphics are CC BY 4.0; schemas, fixtures, workflows, scripts and reference code remain Apache-2.0. Metadata is prepared before publication; the public release timestamp and verified archive establish actual publication.
notes: Release-level CC BY 4.0 metadata describes the normative standard. Individual implementation artifacts remain Apache-2.0 as declared by LICENSE.md.
